coordinate_system: Y-up, -Z forward; one exported unit is one meter

asset_contract.title: Ray cannon
asset_contract.summary: The ship's spirit-beam gun, built like a deck harpoon: a wooden plinth and tripod carrying a slim iron post, a brass turntable and iron fork on it, and the gun on its trunnions: a long iron barrel on a timber stock with brass focusing collars, a spirit crystal clasped along the breech, two spade grips behind, and a harpoon head of three barbed brass prongs closing round a crystal at the muzzle. The CannonStation fixture.
asset_contract.placement: Pivot at the centre of the deck under the post. The barrel points +Z at rest; the gunner's Seat is at (0, 1.05, -1.8). Height about 2.7 m (the breech crystal); the post and plinth stand in 1 m.

nodes.name: RayCannon_Base
nodes.role: Static: plinth with rivets, tripod braces on brass shoes, the banded iron post and the bearing collar.

nodes.name: RayCannon_Yoke
nodes.role: Moving part (yaw). Pivot at (0, 2.4, 0), the prefab's YawPivot; turns about local Y. Turntable, lacquered ring, the two fork cheeks and the trunnion pin.

nodes.name: RayCannon_Barrel
nodes.role: Moving part (pitch). Pivot at (0, 2.4, 0), the prefab's PitchPivot; pitches about local X, -15 to +40 degrees (CannonConfig) without touching the yoke. The muzzle crystal ends at z 2.28, just behind the prefab's Muzzle (z 2.3) where the beam starts.

asset_contract.materials: RayCannon_Wood, RayCannon_Brass, RayCannon_Iron, RayCannon_Paint, RayCannon_Spirit; CannonAssetBuilder swaps each for the shared ship material (M_ShipHull, M_ShipEngine, M_ShipIron, M_ShipPennant, M_ShipSpirit).
asset_contract.collision: One box round the post on the prefab (1 x 2.6 x 1 m): what Interact aims at and what blocks walking. No mesh collider.
asset_contract.movable_parts: The yoke and barrel move with the aim (they sit under YawPivot and PitchPivot).
